lines.text: Because Israel did evil, the LORD gave them to Midian for seven years, and they sheltered in mountains and caves.
Midianites and Amalekites invaded whenever Israel planted, camping as far as Hebron and destroying the produce of the land.
The angel of the LORD found Gideon threshing wheat in a winepress and sent him to save Israel from Midian.
Gideon laid a young goat and unleavened bread on a rock, and fire flared from the rock and consumed them.
The LORD told Gideon to tear down Baal's altar, and Gideon took twelve servants and did it by night.
